column4: It checks whether x and y are references to the same object\nWe call this kind of checking as “identity test”

If X and Y are objects, and Y is a shallow copy of X, then:
- All primitive attributes of X are copied into Y
- Both X and Y share the non-primitive instance variables
- If an immutable object changes, a new object will be created
- If a mutable object changes, it remains shared
If X and Y are objects, and Y is a deep copy of X, then:\n- All attributes are copied into Y\n
